items.title: Publish your own books on Amazon KDP, using AI only within its rules
items.summary: Write your own books, use AI tools to edit and refine them, and publish through KDP while following its AI-content disclosure rules. The source gives no income figure, and results vary.

items.title: Sell digital downloads you design yourself on Etsy
items.summary: Etsy lets sellers list digital files, as long as the seller made or designed them. AI tools can help you brainstorm, but this Etsy page does not address AI, so check Etsy's current rules first. No income figure is given.
